newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian MinFins firm, trade thin ahead of New Year.
newsitem.headline: Russian MinFins firm, trade thin ahead of New Year.

text.p: Prices of Russian MinFin bonds firmed on the first trading day after Christmas but the market remains thin, with Russian operators staying out ahead of New Year and Orthodox Christmas, dealers said on Monday.
January 1 to 4 are New Year holidays in Russia, January 5 and 6 are working days and January 7 is celebrated as Orthodox Christmas.
"There were some deals in early trading and prices edged up. But interest is seen only in London, with Moscow doing nothing before the holidays," an International Moscow Bank dealer said.
Dealers said deals were struck through brokers on the illiquid market.
